page.notes: Long s is printed as s throughout and is given as plain s. Two readings are uncertain: "Mases" in the last Act. 26 sentence is printed as "Moses" and the scan is faint, so it should be checked; "rectâ" in the running head is also faint. The "Chriftus" ligature is transcribed as "Christus". The paragraph ending "loquuntur," continues on the next page.
